clips.title: The story
paras: Moonglade is an ancient, secluded forest valley nestled high in northern Kalimdor, revered as the sacred heartland of druidism and the home of the Cenarion Circle. Sheltered beneath perpetual twilight and untouched by mortal corruption, it is a neutral haven where night elf and tauren practitioners study nature side by side. For non-druids, reaching this highland sanctuary requires braving the hazardous mountain tunnel of Timbermaw Hold.

Ringed by sheer mountains north of Felwood and Winterspring, Moonglade exists in a state of eternal, serene night under the soft glow of Elune's moon. At its center lies Lake Elune'ara, a deep, tranquil body of water held sacred since the dawn of kaldorei civilization. The glade remained unmarred by the Burning Legion during both ancient invasions and the recent Third War, shielded by the vigilant demigod Cenarius and his offspring. Today, under the stewardship of Keeper Remulos, the valley serves as a peaceful redoubt where nature's balance is preserved free from factional conflict.
